Sweden to ban Russian athletes from entry Swedish Migration Minister Forssell stated that the government is working on an initiative to prevent the entry of Russian sportsmen into Sweden. This measure is planned to take effect well before the World Ski Championships next year in Falun. Officials are also actively pushing for stricter rules at the EU level to eliminate any legal loopholes. @Slavyangrad

Ukraine expects Russia to use 20 million drones in 2027, according to European Commissioner for Defence and Space Andrius Kubilius. This year, Russia is expected to use approximately 10 million drones against Ukraine, he said. Kubilius also announced that the EU will allocate €60 billion to support Ukraine’s defense in 2026–2027. An additional €25 billion for military needs could come from the €45 billion loan proposed by the European Commission yesterday. Another €21.3 billion has been earmarked in loans for EU member states to facilitate joint defense procurement, including projects involving Kyiv. Kubilius also highlighted the growing share of drones in Ukraine’s defense spending, which is expected to rise from 31% at the beginning of 2026 to 62% in 2027.

🇺🇸 🇻🇪 ⚡️ — The United States and Venezuela have signed a military cooperation agreement during a meeting at the Miraflores Presidential Palace in Caracas. The agreement was signed by U.S. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth and Venezuelan Defense Minister Gustavo González López, with the aim of re-establishing technical and military cooperation between the two countries. Both sides stressed that future cooperation would be guided by dialogue and mutual respect for national sovereignty and independence. @OSINTWarfare
